tips.text: Run Bifrost Echo or Beacon Shield Ring on Venus Proxima; the roll is one per mission, so the shortest node wins.
Join a public squad as a client; you fly their built Railjack and skip the Railjack work.
Skip endless Void Storm nodes; they give the same single roll for far more time.
Finish every mission; aborting or failing voids that mission's roll.
Shield-gate the Void Sinks with Rolling Guard or the Augur set, or bring a Voidrig Necramech; Frost, Limbo or Gara bubbles absorb sinks outside them.
Check the Railjack star chart for which Void Storm nodes are live instead of assuming Bifrost Echo is up.
Treat Epitaph as a side effect of a Holokey farm; go in for Holokeys and come out with the gun.
Expect about 20 to 45 missions for a full set; the complaint is boredom, not length.
